inclusions.source: Two days, a private 4×4 and driver, from Cairo into the Bahariya Oasis — the gateway oasis of the Western Desert, roughly 370 kilometres south-west of the city, in a depression below the level of the surrounding plateau.
Character · Fully private · your own guide and 4×4 driver · oasis lodge stay · brisk pace, long driving days
Duration · 2 days / 1 night (at an oasis lodge) — extendable to 3 days with a White Desert overnight

itinerary.title: Bahariya: the oasis day
itinerary.overnight: Oasis lodge (Sands Bahariya or one of its peers)
itinerary.source: Check-in is at a working oasis lodge — the Sands Bahariya, or one of its peers — and the afternoon is the oasis proper.

itinerary.title: The antiquities, the deserts, the drive back
itinerary.source: The return drive to Cairo brings the trip back to the city by late evening.
